title: Phase 31 social cutover feature flag contract
invalidValuePolicy: Use the per-flag failSafeValue, report INVALID_VALUE_FAIL_SAFE, and fail shared environment validation.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_LEADS
flags.purpose: Authorizes the Phase 31 platform Lead Ads path; false preserves legacy authority until cutover.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM
flags.purpose: Authorizes the Phase 31 platform Instagram read path; writes remain independently disabled.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_LEGACY_FACEBOOK
flags.purpose: Keeps the legacy Facebook path available until observed platform cutover and rollback proof complete.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_SOCIAL_REALTIME
flags.purpose: Authorizes the normalized platform realtime bridge; false prevents unobserved bridge authority.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_SOCIAL_WEBHOOKS
flags.purpose: Authorizes platform social webhook processing authority; false preserves the pre-cutover path.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM_WRITES
flags.purpose: Allows controlled Instagram standard reply writes only after the platform read path is verified.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM_PRIVATE_REPLY
flags.purpose: Allows Instagram private reply writes as a separate one-shot policy-controlled capability.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_SOCIAL_MEDIA_DOWNLOADS
flags.purpose: Allows bounded social media download and validation jobs after storage and scanner readiness.

flags.name: META_PLATFORM_SOCIAL_REPLAY
flags.purpose: Allows approval-backed social replay after dedupe, policy, and rollback controls are verified.

compatibilityControls.name: META_PHASE31_LEAD_RUNTIME
compatibilityControls.note: Lead cutover selector reconciled in Item 8.3. SHADOW keeps legacy authority and runs side-effect-free platform parity; PLATFORM requires both canonical Lead and webhook flags.

compatibilityControls.name: META_PHASE31_INSTAGRAM_INBOUND_RUNTIME
compatibilityControls.note: Instagram read selector reconciled in Item 8.4. SHADOW keeps legacy authority and performs side-effect-free normalized parity; PLATFORM requires canonical Instagram and webhook flags.

compatibilityControls.name: META_PHASE31_INSTAGRAM_OUTBOUND_RUNTIME
compatibilityControls.note: Instagram outbound selector reconciled in Item 8.4. Standard/private writes remain independently fail-closed and are re-evaluated at worker execution time.

compatibilityControls.name: META_PHASE31_INSTAGRAM_MEDIA_RUNTIME
compatibilityControls.note: Instagram media selector reconciled in Item 8.4. Metadata persists while provider media downloads require the separate fail-closed media-download flag.

compatibilityControls.name: META_PHASE31_FACEBOOK_INBOX_RUNTIME
compatibilityControls.note: Facebook/realtime selector reconciled in Item 8.5. SHADOW keeps realtime legacy authority and mirrors signed input for side-effect-free platform parity; PLATFORM requires legacy disabled plus platform realtime and webhook flags.

compatibilityControls.name: META_PHASE31_PAGE_DOMAIN_RUNTIME
compatibilityControls.note: Existing Page-domain selector retained until final Facebook cutover.

compatibilityControls.name: REALTIME_FACEBOOK_MODE
compatibilityControls.note: Realtime service selector; legacy mode still requires REALTIME_FACEBOOK_LEGACY_ROLLBACK_ENABLED=true.
